entries.title: Matthew 28:1
segments: ¶Now after the Sabbath, as the first [day] of the week began to dawn, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.

entries.title: Matthew 28:2
segments: And behold, there was a great earthquake; for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat on it.

entries.title: Matthew 28:3
segments: His countenance was like lightning, and his clothing as white as snow.

entries.title: Matthew 28:4
segments: And the guards shook for fear of him, and became like dead [men].

entries.title: Matthew 28:5
segments: But the angel answered and said to the women, "Do not be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus who was crucified.

entries.title: Matthew 28:6
segments: "He is not here; for He is risen, as He said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.

entries.title: Matthew 28:7
segments: "And go quickly and tell His disciples that He is risen from the dead, and indeed He is going before you into Galilee; there you will see Him. Behold, I have told you."

entries.title: Matthew 28:8
segments: So they went out quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring His disciples word.

entries.title: Matthew 28:9
segments: And as they went to tell His disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, "Rejoice!" So they came and held Him by the feet and worshiped Him.

entries.title: Matthew 28:10
segments: Then Jesus said to them, "Do not be afraid. Go [and] tell My brethren to go to Galilee, and there they will see Me."

entries.title: Matthew 28:11
segments: ¶Now while they were going, behold, some of the guard came into the city and reported to the chief priests all the things that had happened.

entries.title: Matthew 28:12
segments: When they had assembled with the elders and consulted together, they gave a large sum of money to the soldiers,

entries.title: Matthew 28:13
segments: saying, "Tell them, 'His disciples came at night and stole Him [away] while we slept.'

entries.title: Matthew 28:14
segments: "And if this comes to the governor's ears, we will appease him and make you secure."

entries.title: Matthew 28:15
segments: So they took the money and did as they were instructed; and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.

entries.title: Matthew 28:16
segments: ¶Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, to the mountain which Jesus had appointed for them.

entries.title: Matthew 28:17
segments: When they saw Him, they worshiped Him; but some doubted.

entries.title: Matthew 28:18
segments: And Jesus came and spoke to them, saying, "All authority has been given to Me in heaven and on earth.

entries.title: Matthew 28:19
segments: "Go therefore and make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

entries.title: Matthew 28:20
segments: "teaching them to observe all things that I have commanded you; and lo, I am with you always, [even] to the end of the age." Amen.
